title: inspect_ranges.host

reference: inspect_ranges.host

The range-host extension point: a `HostBackendFactory` named by `INSPECT_RANGES_HOST=<module>.<factory>[:<config>]` returns a `HostBackend` bundle, and the lease machinery and channel tier it builds on are public here. See [Implementing a Host Provider](../topology.qmd#implementing-a-host-provider) for the grammar, the registration walkthrough, and the contracts an implementation is held to.
